content_sections.text: Maximum 40 years for men and 45 years for women as on the date of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process for ANGRAU Physical Director
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected based on their performance in the walk-in interview, subject to fulfilling the essential qualifications and producing original certificates. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in interview on 14 October 2026 from 10:30 AM onwards at the Polytechnic of Agriculture, Rampachodavaram, Polavaram District, bringing all original certificates, mark sheets, testimonials, self-attested copies from matriculation onwards, and original experience certificates (as applicable).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: All original certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards Testimonials in original One set of self-attested copies of all certificates from matriculation onwards Original experience certificate (as applicable)

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Physical Director Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a temporary and contractual basis for 11 months, and incumbents have no claim for regular appointment or further continuation. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form leads to disqualification or termination even after appointment. The appointment may be terminated at any time without notice or assigning any reason. Appointees may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice. Candidates have no right to claim employment or engagement in ANGRAU-Constituent colleges after the contract period ends. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination at their own expense to ensure physical fitness before appointment. The Principal reserves the right to cancel or withdraw any position.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: This notification is for the contractual recruitment of a Physical Director (Part Time) at the Polytechnic of Agriculture, Rampachodavaram.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is only 1 vacancy available for the Physical Director (Part Time) post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 14 October 2026 from 10:30 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Physical Education from a UGC/AICTE recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women as on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must attend the walk-in interview directly at the venue with all original documents and one set of self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a purely temporary and contractual engagement for 11 months with no claim for regular appointment.
